record.dic_text:
06820 Tso`ar {tso'ar}

源自 06819; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Zoar 10; 10

瑣珥 = "不重要"
1) 在死海東南方的一座城市, 與所多瑪和蛾摩拉為同類, 
   乃是因毀滅而被上帝嚴重懲罰的五個城市之一;
   因羅得懇求作為其避難所而倖免
record.edic_text:
06820 Tso`ar {tso'ar}

from 06819;; n pr loc

AV - Zoar 10; 10

Zoar = "insignificance"
1) a city at the southeast end of the Dead Sea grouped with Sodom and
   Gomorrah as being one of the 5 cities slated for destruction by God;
   spared at Lot's plea as his place of refuge
